newsitem.title: DUBAI: Arabsat expects to double profits in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Arabsat expects to double profits in 1997.

text.p: Arab Satellite Communication Organisation (Arabsat) expects to double its profits for the current year to $60 million, Arabic daily Asharq al-Awsat reported on Tuesday.
The London-based paper said state-owned Arabsat based its forecast on expected returns from high investments and complete leasing of all channels available on the organisation's two satellites.
Arabsat last September awarded a $90 million contract to France's Aerospatiale for its third second-generation satellite scheduled to be launched in 1988 or early 1999.
Arabsat, which operates satellite communications for Arab countries including television, telephone and data transmission, is owned by 21 Arab countries.
